record.original_question: Let φ_a: D → L be the universal covering of a leaf, let A(r) = ∫_{D(r)} φ_a^*(ω), and define the associated Ahlfors current by σ_r^a := (1/A(r))(φ_a)_*[D(r)]. Does σ_r^a converge to the extremal positive ddc-closed current T as r tends to 1 for T-almost every base point a?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a compact Kähler surface endowed with a Hermitian form ω, and let F be a holomorphic foliation by Riemann surfaces on X with only hyperbolic singularities and no directed positive closed (1,1)-current. Under these hypotheses there exists a unique (up to scalar) extremal positive ddc-closed (1,1)-current T directed by F. For each regular point a ∈ X, let L_a denote the leaf through a and let φ_a : D → L_a be the universal covering of L_a, normalized so that φ_a(0) = a, where D ⊂ ℂ is the unit disc. For 0 < r < 1, let D(r) ⊂ D be the disc of radius r and define the area
   A(r) := ∫_{D(r)} φ_a^* ω.
Define the associated Ahlfors current
   σ_r^a := (1/A(r)) (φ_a)_* [D(r)],
where [D(r)] is the current of integration over D(r). 

Question: Does σ_r^a converge (weakly, as currents) to T as r → 1, for T-almost every base point a ∈ X?
artifact.status_search_result: Related unique-ergodicity results by Dinh–Sibony and collaborators establish convergence of Cesàro-type averages of weighted (harmonic) currents to the extremal ddc-closed current T for foliations on ℙ² and on compact Kähler surfaces. However, the search did not surface a result establishing convergence of the un-weighted Ahlfors currents σ_r^a to T for T-almost every base point a as r → 1; the question appears to remain a stated open problem in this line of research.

status_evidence.title: Unique Ergodicity for foliations on compact Kähler surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and uniqueness of an extremal positive ddc-closed (1,1)-current directed by F under genericity/hyperbolicity assumptions; convergence of harmonic-type averages.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the existence/uniqueness of T and unique ergodicity results for weighted currents, but does not directly prove the un-weighted Ahlfors-current convergence.

status_evidence.title: Unique ergodicity for foliations in P² with an invariant curve
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence of leaf averages to the extremal directed ddc-closed current in the P² setting.
status_evidence.claim: Provides analogous convergence statements but in restricted settings, leaving the general Ahlfors-current question open.

status_evidence.title: Generating all Ahlfors currents by a single entire curve
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on Ahlfors currents and Sibony-type conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates ongoing activity around Ahlfors currents without resolving the foliation-leaf convergence problem stated.
